records.title: Hermosa Beach
records.content: Hermosa is directly south along The Strand, reachable by car, bike, or a longer walk from Manhattan Beach. Center a visit on the beach and pier, then choose a nearby restaurant. A relaxed plan is a late-afternoon shoreline walk followed by dinner; the atmosphere can become livelier after dark.

records.title: Malibu
records.content: Treat Malibu as a flexible coastal half- or full-day drive. Pair Malibu Surfrider Beach and Malibu Pier with one or two scenic shoreline stops. Check directly with dining venues. Traffic and parking can change the rhythm of the day.

records.title: Manhattan Beach
records.content: Start with beach time, Manhattan Beach Pier, The Strand, and downtown. Downtown has a compact mix of restaurants, coffee, shops, and markets. For families, a beach-and-pier walk is a simple flexible outing. Parking is limited near the sand, so read posted signs and allow extra time on busy beach days.

records.title: Redondo Beach
records.content: Redondo offers the pier, waterfront promenades, and marina area. It is an easy family outing: pair a pier stroll with beach time and a casual meal. The waterfront has several parking areas, though availability and posted rules vary.

records.title: Santa Monica
records.content: Santa Monica works after Venice or as its own outing. The pier and beachfront are the landmarks; Third Street Promenade and nearby downtown blocks offer walking and shopping. Drive times vary significantly with traffic, so keep the schedule flexible.

records.title: Venice
records.content: Venice is north of the South Bay; rideshare or a car is generally simplest. Walk the Venice Beach Boardwalk, slow the pace at the Venice Canals, and browse independent shops, coffee, galleries, and restaurants on Abbot Kinney Boulevard. Venice combines naturally with Santa Monica.

records.title: Published cancellation terms
records.content: For an accepted direct booking, cancel at least 14 days before scheduled check-in for a 100% refund of refundable booking charges; between 7 and less than 14 days for a 50% refund of nightly accommodation charges; less than 7 days before check-in means nightly accommodation charges are non-refundable. Applicable California cancellation rights can override this schedule. The host confirms the terms that apply to an accepted stay.

records.content: For an immediate threat to life or property in the United States, call 911. For a property issue that is urgent but not an emergency, contact the host through the established guest communication channel. The concierge cannot dispatch emergency help.

records.title: Ocean safety
records.content: Ocean conditions can change quickly. Swim near a lifeguard when available, follow posted warnings, supervise children closely, and do not enter water beyond your ability. Check current beach conditions directly before swimming or surfing.

records.title: Arriving from LAX
records.content: Los Angeles International Airport is the closest major airport for most guests. Rideshare or a rental car are the simplest general options. en.question: What are the published cancellation terms for an accepted direct booking?
en.answer: For an accepted direct booking, the published terms say: cancel at least 14 days before scheduled check-in for a 100% refund of refundable booking charges; between 7 and less than 14 days for a 50% refund of nightly accommodation charges; less than 7 days before check-in means nightly accommodation charges are non-refundable. Applicable California cancellation rights can override this schedule, and the host confirms the terms for the accepted stay.
alternativeQuestions: Can you tell me more about this: What are the published cancellation terms for an accepted direct booking?

it.question: Quali sono i termini di cancellazione pubblicati per una prenotazione diretta accettata?
it.answer: Per una prenotazione diretta accettata, i termini pubblicati indicano: cancellazione almeno 14 giorni prima del check-in previsto per il rimborso del 100% degli importi rimborsabili; tra 7 e meno di 14 giorni per il rimborso del 50% delle tariffe notturne; meno di 7 giorni prima del check-in significa che le tariffe notturne non sono rimborsabili. Eventuali diritti di cancellazione applicabili in California possono prevalere e l’host conferma le condizioni della prenotazione accettata.
alternativeQuestions: Puoi dirmi di più su questo: Quali sono i termini di cancellazione pubblicati per una prenotazione diretta accettata?

es.question: ¿Cuáles son los términos de cancelación publicados para una reserva directa aceptada?
es.answer: Para una reserva directa aceptada, los términos publicados dicen: cancelar al menos 14 días antes del check-in programado para un reembolso del 100% de los gastos de reserva reembolsables; entre 7 y menos de 14 días para un reembolso del 50% de los gastos de alojamiento nocturno; menos de 7 días antes del check-in significa que los gastos de alojamiento nocturno no son reembolsables. Los derechos de cancelación aplicables de California pueden anular este horario, y el anfitrión confirma los términos para la estancia aceptada.
alternativeQuestions: ¿Cuáles son los términos de cancelación publicados para una reserva directa aceptada?

fr.question: Quelles sont les conditions d'annulation publiées pour une réservation directe acceptée?
fr.answer: Pour une réservation directe acceptée, les conditions publiées disent: annuler au moins 14 jours avant l'arrivée prévue pour un remboursement de 100% des frais de réservation remboursables; entre 7 et moins de 14 jours pour un remboursement de 50% des frais de logement nocturne; moins de 7 jours avant l'arrivée signifie que les frais de logement nocturne sont non remboursables. Les droits d'annulation applicables en Californie peuvent dépasser ce calendrier, et l'hâte confirme les conditions du séjour accepté.
alternativeQuestions: Quelles sont les conditions d'annulation publiées pour une réservation directe acceptée?

de.question: Was sind die veröffentlichten Stornierungsbedingungen für eine akzeptierte Direktbuchung?
de.answer: Für eine akzeptierte Direktbuchung sagen die veröffentlichten Bedingungen: Stornieren Sie mindestens 14 Tage vor dem geplanten Check-in für eine 100% Rückerstattung der erstattungsfähigen Buchungsgebühren; zwischen 7 und weniger als 14 Tagen für eine 50% Rückerstattung der Übernachtungsgebühren; weniger als 7 Tage vor dem Check-in bedeutet, dass die Übernachtungsgebühren nicht erstattungsfähig sind. Geltende kalifornische Stornierungsrechte können diesen Zeitplan außer Kraft setzen, und der Gastgeber bestätigt die Bedingungen für den akzeptierten Aufenthalt.
alternativeQuestions: Was sind die veröffentlichten Stornierungsbedingungen für eine akzeptierte Direktbuchung?

en.question: What should we know about ocean safety?
en.answer: Ocean conditions can change quickly. Swim near a lifeguard when available, follow posted warnings, supervise children closely and do not enter water beyond your ability. Check current conditions before swimming or surfing.
alternativeQuestions: Can you tell me more about this: What should we know about ocean safety?

it.question: Cosa dobbiamo sapere sulla sicurezza in oceano?
it.answer: Le condizioni dell’oceano possono cambiare rapidamente. Nuotate vicino a un bagnino quando disponibile, rispettate gli avvisi, sorvegliate attentamente i bambini e non entrate in acqua oltre le vostre capacità. Controllate le condizioni attuali prima di nuotare o fare surf.
alternativeQuestions: Puoi dirmi di più su questo: Cosa dobbiamo sapere sulla sicurezza in oceano?

es.question: ¿Qué deberíamos saber sobre seguridad oceánica?
es.answer: Las condiciones del océano pueden cambiar rápidamente. Camine cerca de un salvavidas cuando está disponible, siga alertas publicadas, supervise a los niños de cerca y no entre en agua más allá de su capacidad. Compruebe las condiciones actuales antes de nadar o surfear.
alternativeQuestions: ¿Qué deberíamos saber sobre seguridad oceánica?

fr.question: Que devons-nous savoir sur la sécurité des océans?
fr.answer: Les conditions océaniques peuvent changer rapidement. Nagez prés d'un sauveteur quand il est disponible, suivez les avertissements affichés, surveillez étroitement les enfants et n'entrez pas dans l'eau au-delà de vos capacités. Vérifiez les conditions actuelles avant de nager ou de surfer.
alternativeQuestions: Que devons-nous savoir sur la sécurité des océans?
